args.name: :configuration
args.description:
Selected manager's configuration to read. The configuration to read depends on the selected component. The following table shows all available combinations of component and configuration values:

Component Configuration Source
auth auth auth section of etc/wazuh-manager.conf
request global global section of etc/wazuh-manager.conf
request remote remote section of etc/wazuh-manager.conf
request internal remoted.* keys of etc/wazuh-manager-internal-options.conf
wazuh-manager-db internal wazuh_db.* keys of etc/wazuh-manager-internal-options.conf
wazuh-manager-db wdb wdb section of etc/wazuh-manager.conf
wmodules wmodules module configuration reported by wazuh-manager-modulesd (vulnerability-detection, agent-upgrade, task-manager)

endpoints.name: /cluster/:node_id/status
endpoints.description: Return whether the node is ready to process events. Each daemon reports running (PID check) and ready; analysisd embeds the engine resources (spaces/IOC/geo) and modulesd embeds vulnerability-detector. remoted embeds enrollment_password/keystore readiness, and reports a reason: "admin socket unreachable" field instead of ready: false when its own admin socket cannot be reached while the daemon itself keeps running. The node-level ready is true only when every daemon is ready. wazuh-manager-apid is only reported on the master node, as it does not run on workers.

endpoints.name: /agents/insert
endpoints.description: Add an agent specifying its name, ID and IP. If an agent with the same name or the same IP already exists, replace it using the `force` parameter. The agent ID is never replaced: an ID that belongs to an existing agent is rejected with error 1708, and an ID whose previous owner still has documents pending deletion in the indexer is rejected with error 1763 - delete the agent and let its deletion complete before reusing its ID. An explicit ID outside `[1, 2147483647]`, or `0`, is rejected with error 1765

id.description: Agent ID. Must be a positive integer no greater than 2147483647 (2^31-1), and other than 0, which is reserved for the manager

key.description: Key to use when communicating with the manager. The agent must have the same key on its `client.keys` file

ip.description: If this is not included, the API will get the IP automatically. Allowed values: IP, IP/NET, ANY

force.description: Remove the old agent with the same name, ID or IP if the configuration is matched

value.description: Time the agent must has been disconnected to force the insertion. Time in seconds, ‘[n_days]d’, ‘[n_hours]h’, ‘[n_minutes]m’ or ‘[n_seconds]s’. For example, `7d`, `10s` and `10` are valid values. If no time unit is specified, seconds are used

after_registration_time.description: Time the agent must has been registered to force the insertion. Time in seconds, ‘[n_days]d’, ‘[n_hours]h’, ‘[n_minutes]m’ or ‘[n_seconds]s’. For example, `7d`, `10s` and `10` are valid values. If no time unit is specified, seconds are used
